title: 🎨 Palette: Improve small quantity button touch targets
body:
### What
Added a 12-point `hitSlop` in all directions to the increase and decrease/remove quantity icon buttons within the `NewOrderItemsSection` component of the mobile admin app.

### Why
The previous touch targets for the `qtyBtn` components were restricted to their 32x32px container size. This is difficult to tap reliably on mobile devices and causes accidental mis-taps when users try to adjust product quantities during order creation.

### Accessibility
This change improves WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for touch target minimum sizes. By adding a 12-point `hitSlop` on all sides (top, bottom, left, right), the effective interactive area for each button expands from 32x32px to 56x56px, comfortably exceeding the 44x44px minimum required by accessibility standards without negatively impacting the visual layout.

### Impact
Users interacting with the manual order creation flow (`NewOrderItemsSection`) on mobile devices will experience a much smoother, more forgiving interaction when incrementing or decrementing product quantities. Screen reader/accessibility users also benefit from the more reliable tap area.
